Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure stacks two panels, labeled (a) and (b), each plotting projectile trajectories that leave and return to the same level ground line. In panel (a) three parabolic arcs share one launch point and an angle marked 45 degrees, distinguished by velocity arrows at the origin labeled 30 m/s in orange, 40 m/s in purple, and 50 m/s in teal; a key at the upper right shows y up and x right. Dashed verticals drop from each apex, and three dimension bars beneath the ground line read R = 91.8 m, R = 163 m, and R = 255 m in that same order. Panel (b) instead fixes the speed, labeled v0 = 50 m/s, and varies the angle, with nested arcs at the origin marking 15, 45, and 75 degrees; only two dimension bars appear, R = 128 m ending at a dashed vertical where both the 15-degree and 75-degree curves land, and R = 255 m spanning the 45-degree curve. Matching each color-coded launch arrow to its own range bar isolates one launch parameter at a time. The layout supports the range relationship, in which range grows with the square of initial speed, peaks at 45 degrees, and repeats for complementary angles whose apex heights differ.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Slider for initial speed in panel (a): the learner drags v0 while theta stays at 45 degrees, the trajectory, apex guide, landing point, and range bar update together, making clear that range grows with v0^2 when angle is fixed.
- Slider for launch angle in panel (b): the learner drags theta at fixed v0 = 50 m/s, the parabola and range bar reshape, and complementary angles highlight when they land at the same point, making clear why 45 degrees maximizes range while 15 degrees and 75 degrees share range but not height.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax University Physics, chapter 4: Motion in Two and Three Dimensions

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

r.toFixed(1) : String(Math.round(r)); } function addHaloText(g, str, x, y, size, anchor, color, weight) { var t = g.text(str); t.font({ family: 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif', size: size, anchor: anchor || 'middle', weight: weight || 'normal' }); t.attr({ x: x, y: y, 'dominant-baseline': 'middle' }); t.fill(color || black); t.attr({ 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#ffffff', 'stroke-width': 4, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }); return t; } function arrowShape(g, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width, headLen, headWid) { var grp = g.group(); var dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1; var len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1; var ux = dx / len, uy = dy / len; var px = -uy, py = ux; headLen = headLen || 12; headWid = headWid || 8; grp.line(x1, y1, x2, y2).stroke({ color: color, width: width || 3, linecap: 'round' }); grp.polygon([ [x2, y2], [x2 - ux * headLen + px * headWid / 2, y2 - uy * headLen + py * headWid / 2], [x2 - ux * headLen - px * headWid / 2, y2 - uy * headLen - py * headWid / 2] ]).fill(color).stroke('none'); return grp; } function projectilePath(g, p, v, deg, color, width, opacity) { var m = metrics(v, deg); var th = m.theta; var d = ''; for (var i = 0; i <= 90; i++) { var x = m.R * i / 90; var y = x * Math.tan(th) - g0 * x * x / (2 * v * v * Math.cos(th) * Math.cos(th)); if (i === 90) y = 0; var pt = mapPoint(p, x, y); d += (i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L') + pt[0].toFixed(2) + ' ' + pt[1].toFixed(2) + ' '; } var path = g.path(d).fill('none').stroke({ color: color, width: width || 2, linecap: 'round', linejoin: 'round' }); if (opacity != null) path.opacity(opacity); path.css('cursor', 'pointer'); path.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Projectile path: y = x tanθ − gx²/(2v₀²cos²θ).', e); }).on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }).on('click', function () { showPopup('Projectile trajectory', 'For launch and landing at the same height, the horizontal range is R = v₀² sin(2θ)/g. The curve is parabolic because horizontal velocity is constant while vertical velocity changes under gravity.'); }); return path; } function apexGuide(g, p, v, deg, color, opacity) { var m = metrics(v, deg); var top = mapPoint(p, m.apexX, m.H); var base = mapPoint(p, m.apexX, 0); var l = g.line(base[0], base[1], top[0], top[1]).stroke({ color: color || grey, width: 1.4, dasharray: '7,5' }); if (opacity != null) l.opacity(opacity); return l; } function dimBar(g, p, R, y, label, color) { var x1 = p.ox, x2 = p.ox + R * p.xs; var grp = g.group(); grp.line(x1, y, x2, y).stroke({ color: black, width: 1.4 }); grp.line(x1, p.gy + 6, x1, y + 12).stroke({ color: black, width: 1.4 }); grp.line(x2, y - 10, x2, y + 10).stroke({ color: black, width: 1.2 }); arrowShape(grp, x1 + 20, y, x1 + 2, y, black, 1.2, 7, 6); arrowShape(grp, x2 - 20, y, x2 - 2, y, black, 1.2, 7, 6); addHaloText(grp, label, (x1 + x2) / 2, y - 2, 18, 'middle', color || black, 'normal'); grp.css('cursor', 'pointer'); grp.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip(label + ' is the horizontal distance from launch to landing.', e); }) .on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Range bar', 'The range bar measures only horizontal displacement. In these panels the projectile lands at the same vertical height from which it was launched.'); }); return grp; } function angleArc(g, p, radius, deg, color, label, labelShift) { var cx = p.ox, cy = p.gy; var a1 = 0, a2 = deg * Math.PI / 180; var sx = cx + radius, sy = cy; var ex = cx + radius * Math.cos(a2), ey = cy - radius * Math.sin(a2); var large = deg > 180 ? 1 : 0; g.path('M' + sx + ' ' + sy + ' A' + radius + ' ' + radius + ' 0 ' + large + ' 0 ' + ex + ' ' + ey) .fill('none').stroke({ color: color, width: 1.3 }); var mid = a2 / 2; addHaloText(g, label, cx + (radius + (labelShift || 12)) * Math.cos(mid), cy - (radius + (labelShift || 12)) * Math.sin(mid), 16, 'middle', black); } function drawGroundAndAxes() { staticLayer.line(panelA.ox, panelA.gy, 592, panelA.gy).stroke({ color: black, width: 1.2 }); staticLayer.line(panelB.ox, panelB.gy, 592, panelB.gy).stroke({ color: black, width: 1.2 }); arrowShape(staticLayer, 525, 70, 585, 70, black, 1.4, 8, 6); arrowShape(staticLayer, 525, 70, 525, 8, black, 1.4, 8, 6); addHaloText(staticLayer, 'x', 596, 74, 17, 'middle', black, 'bold'); addHaloText(staticLayer, 'y', 513, 12, 17, 'middle', black, 'bold'); addHaloText(staticLayer, '(a)', 360, 340, 20, 'middle', black); addHaloText(staticLayer, '(b)', 360, 710, 20, 'middle', black); } function drawPanelAStatic() { angleArc(staticLayer, panelA, 38, 45, black, '45°', 14); projectilePath(staticLayer, panelA, 30, 45, orange, 2, 1); projectilePath(staticLayer, panelA, 40, 45, purple, 2, 1); apexGuide(staticLayer, panelA, 30, 45, grey, 0.9); apexGuide(staticLayer, panelA, 40, 45, grey, 0.9); var a30 = arrowShape(staticLayer, panelA.ox, panelA.gy, panelA.ox + 62, panelA.gy - 62, orange, 3, 12, 8); var a40 = arrowShape(staticLayer, panelA.ox, panelA.gy, panelA.ox + 83, panelA.gy - 83, purple, 3, 12, 8); addHaloText(staticLayer, '30 m/s', panelA.ox - 5, panelA.gy - 48, 17, 'end', black); addHaloText(staticLayer, '40 m/s', panelA.ox - 8, panelA.gy - 86, 17, 'end', black); dimBar(staticLayer, panelA, metrics(30, 45).R, 220, 'R = 91.8 m', black); dimBar(staticLayer, panelA, metrics(40, 45).R, 260, 'R = 163 m', black); a30.css('cursor', 'pointer').on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('30 m/s launch at 45°', e); }).on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }); a40.css('cursor', 'pointer').on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('40 m/s launch at 45°', e); }).on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); arrowShape(staticLayer, panelB.ox, panelB.gy, panelB.ox + 82, panelB.gy - 82, purple, 3, 12, 8); angleArc(staticLayer, panelB, 52, 45, purple, '45°', 14); dimBar(staticLayer, panelB, metrics(50, 45).R, 632, 'R = 255 m', black); arr.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Current speed: ' + v + ' m/s. Angle is fixed at 45°.', e); }) .on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Fixed angle, changing speed', 'With θ fixed at 45°, sin(2θ) = 1, so R = v₀²/g. Doubling speed would quadruple the range, because speed is squared in the range formula.'); }); var out = document.getElementById('speedAReadout'); if (out) out.textContent = 'At θ = 45°, R ≈ ' + fmtRange(m.R) + ' m; the square law is visible as the bar length changes.'; } function update_angleB(theta) { dynB.clear(); var comp = 90 - theta; var same = Math.abs(theta - 45) < 0.0001; var cols = lowHighColors(theta); var m = metrics(50, theta); var mc = metrics(50, comp); if (same) { projectilePath(dynB, panelB, 50, 45, purple, 3, 1); apexGuide(dynB, panelB, 50, 45, purple, 0.95); arrowShape(dynB, panelB.ox, panelB.gy, panelB.ox + 91, panelB.gy - 91, purple, 3.4, 13, 9); angleArc(dynB, panelB, 70, 45, purple, '45°', 18); } else { projectilePath(dynB, panelB, 50, theta, cols.selected, 3, 1); projectilePath(dynB, panelB, 50, comp, cols.comp, 2.4, 1); apexGuide(dynB, panelB, 50, theta, cols.selected, 0.95); apexGuide(dynB, panelB, 50, comp, cols.comp, 0.95); var len = 128; var th = theta * Math.PI / 180; var ch = comp * Math.PI / 180; arrowShape(dynB, panelB.ox, panelB.gy, panelB.ox + len * Math.cos(th), panelB.gy - len * Math.sin(th), cols.selected, 3.4, 13, 9); arrowShape(dynB, panelB.ox, panelB.gy, panelB.ox + len * Math.cos(ch), panelB.gy - len * Math.sin(ch), cols.comp, 3.0, 13, 9); var lo = Math.min(theta, comp), hi = Math.max(theta, comp); angleArc(dynB, panelB, 34, lo, theta < 45 ? cols.selected : cols.comp, lo + '°', 13); angleArc(dynB, panelB, 70, hi, theta > 45 ? cols.selected : cols.comp, hi + '°', 16); } var land = mapPoint(panelB, m.R, 0); dynB.circle(8).center(land[0], land[1]).fill(same ? purple : '#222222').opacity(0.85); dimBar(dynB, panelB, m.R, 592, 'R = ' + fmtRange(m.R) + ' m', black); var hit = dynB.rect(24, 155).center(land[0], panelB.gy - 76).fill('#000').opacity(0.001); hit.css('cursor', 'pointer'); hit.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip(same ? '45° gives the maximum range.' : theta + '° and ' + comp + '° land at the same range.', e); }).on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }).on('click', function () { showPopup('Complementary angles', 'The range depends on sin(2θ). Complementary angles θ and 90° − θ have the same sin(2θ), so they land at the same horizontal distance, even though the higher-angle shot reaches a much greater height.'); }); var out = document.getElementById('angleBReadout'); if (out) { out.textContent = same ? 'θ = 45° gives the maximum range, R ≈ ' + fmtRange(m.R) + ' m.' : 'θ = ' + theta + '° and ' + comp + '° share R ≈ ' + fmtRange(m.R) + ' m, but their apex heights differ.'; } } drawGroundAndAxes(); drawPanelAStatic(); drawPanelBStatic(); update_speedA(50); update_angleB(75); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
